meta.ogDescription: Four steps from sign-up to a public, locked record.

title: How Puntr works
intro: Every pick is locked at kick-off, graded automatically and kept forever. Puntr does not take bets or handle money.

s1.title: Sign up with an email code. 18+
s1.body: Enter your email and we send you a one-time code. You confirm that you are 18 or older. No password.

s2.title: Post a pick before kick-off
s2.body: Choose a fixture, a market and a selection, then enter the odds you got.

s3.title: It locks and settles automatically
s3.body: Your pick is timestamped and locked. After the match it is graded from the official result.

s4.title: Climb the weekly leaderboard
s4.body: Your units, ROI and sample size are public. The leaderboard resets every Monday.

rule.r1: Every pick is worth 1 unit at the odds you entered.
rule.r2: Won: you gain (odds - 1) units. Example: 2.10 gives +1.10 units.
rule.r4: Void: 0 units. This covers a match that is postponed, abandoned or cancelled.
rule.r5: Picks are graded from the official full-time result.
rule.r6: If a result is corrected, the correction is logged as a new entry. The earlier entry is never overwritten.

cta.title: Build a record people can trust.
